data.name: Giantslaying Team
data.description: When a giant attempts to hit your ally, that giant unwittingly reveals an opening in her defenses. Whenever a foe with the giant subtype you threaten misses with an attack of opportunity against an ally with this feat, you can make a melee attack against that giant as an immediate action.
prerequisites: PRETEXT:Dex 13, Dodge, Mobility, base attack bonus +4, defensive training racial trait.
